summary: Move the setup and onboarding modules from the st3 library to the binary

replay.detail: Module declarations and paths only. No store, replay or runtime behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The st3 binary, its commands and output are unchanged. st3::setup and st3::onboarding were used only by main.rs; st3::read_cache becomes public, and st3::read_cache::override_kib and st3::service::host_command become public, so the library public surface grows by those two functions.
